dedupe_keys.name: world energy council trilemma index energy security equity and sustainability scores by country online tool and json api

description: The World Energy Council has published the World Energy Trilemma Report and Index since 2010. The Index measures the performance of national energy systems each year on three dimensions: energy security, energy equity and environmental sustainability, for more than 120 countries, and the online Trilemma Index tool shows rankings, country profiles, historical scores and a pathway calculator. The tool's data come from a JSON API that the page calls without a key. The rank data read today hold 133 countries, 126 of them ranked, with overall and per-dimension scores, ranks and letter grades for 2023, Denmark first; the historical scores give the three dimension scores per country and year from 2000, 3,192 rows in all; a statistics table gives land area, population, GDP per capita, GDP growth and industrial share. The 2024 report and executive summary are PDF downloads behind a contact form. Coverage: global, over 120 countries, 2000 to 2023. Format and access: online tool and JSON endpoints; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): copyright World Energy Council; reproduction only as allowed by its copyright notice. Caveats: the index is a composite of national indicators whose method was not read, and the undocumented API may change. Simulation uses: country-level energy security scores as context for energy supply resilience comparisons. Related records: the UN SDG Global Database (data-un-sdg-global-database-api) holds some of the underlying access and renewables indicators.
